That morning, a green glass bottle lay wedged between the rocks below, its cork swollen with salt. He waded out, hands numb, and carried it up to the lamp room. Inside was a single page, ink bleeding but legible: 'To whoever keeps the light, thank you. Your beam brought our boat home in the storm of 1987.' Tomas read it three times. Then he lit the lamp early, just for them.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在薄雾里投下昏黄的光圈，空荡的街道像一条沉睡的河。远处，环卫工人的扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。便利店的灯依旧亮着，收银员趴在柜台上打盹。高架桥上偶尔有一辆货车驶过，留下低沉的回声。窗户大多是黑的，只有零星几盏灯，亮着失眠的人和未完的心事。空气微凉，带着露水和夜宵摊残留的烟火味。再过一会儿，天边会泛起鱼肚白，喧嚣将重新醒来，而此刻，整座城市只属于醒着的人。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job, like opening a Russian nesting doll that has a smaller doll inside.\n- Each time you repeat the job, the problem gets smaller, until you reach the tiniest one that is so easy you can just do it; that is the stopping point.\n- Then you go back up, using each small answer to finish the bigger one, like counting a stack of books by asking 'how many are under this one?' until you reach the last."}
